data.description:
## Goal
Define merge strategies for combining forked minds.

## Interface Contract
```python
class MergeStrategy(Enum):
    UNION = 'union'           # Keep all experiences
    INTERSECTION = 'inter'    # Keep only shared conclusions
    DIFF = 'diff'             # Highlight divergent reasoning
    WEIGHTED = 'weighted'     # Weight by confidence

@dataclass
class MergeResult:
    merged_nodes: Set[str]
    conflicts: List[MergeConflict]
    divergence_points: List[str]
    confidence: float
```

## Location
New file: cortical/reasoning/forking.py

## Test Requirements
- test_merge_strategy_enum()
- test_merge_result_tracks_conflicts()
data.title: Add MergeStrategy enum and MergeResult dataclass
